findings.issue: Webhook secrets stored in plaintext in webhook_endpoints table - no encryption at rest
findings.impact: DB compromise leaks all webhook secrets. Any actor with DB read access (e.g. via SQL injection, backup exposure) obtains secrets for outgoing webhooks.
findings.fix: Encrypt secrets using pgcrypto at insert time, decrypt only at delivery time

findings.issue: GET /consent returns ALL consent records across all users - no user_id filter
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can read other users' cookie/analytics/marketing consent choices. Direct PII exposure of consent preferences.
findings.fix: Add .eq('user_id', req.userId) filter to the query

findings.issue: Thread participants, join, and leave endpoints have no channel membership check. Thread data accessible to any authenticated user.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can enumerate thread participants, join threads in any channel, and view thread membership without being a workspace member.
findings.fix: Add requireChannelAccess middleware to thread routes

findings.issue: Feature flag CRUD endpoints have no admin role check - any authenticated user can create/update/delete feature flags
findings.impact: Any user can modify feature flags affecting all workspaces. Can enable/disable features globally without authorization.
findings.fix: Add requireAdmin or requireWorkspaceOwner middleware to feature-flag mutation endpoints

findings.issue: General API rate limiter uses IP-only key, not composite user+IP key like auth and search limiters
findings.impact: Attacker can rotate IP addresses to bypass the 100 req/min limit. IP-only keys are trivial to circumvent with botnets.
findings.fix: Change keyGenerator from default to compositeKey (same as authLimiter)

findings.issue: requireMessageAccess middleware uses getSupabase() (anon client) for message lookup instead of req.supabase (user JWT client)
findings.impact: Initial message lookup bypasses RLS policies. Though later checks add membership validation, the first query runs without user context.
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase for the initial message lookup

findings.issue: SSRF IP-blocking does not filter 0.0.0.0 or IPv6 [::] addresses
findings.impact: Attacker pointing webhook URL to 0.0.0.0:PORT may bypass SSRF protection on some systems. IPv6 localhost not filtered.
findings.fix: Add '0.' and '[::]' to blocked IP prefixes list, and resolve IPv6 addresses

findings.issue: CSP style-src uses 'unsafe-inline' instead of nonce-based approach
findings.impact: Inline styles permitted broadly. Nonce-based CSP would provide stronger protection against CSS injection attacks.
findings.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonce-based style loading where feasible
